The '''Marisota River''' was a river that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jelph Marrian]] worked on a [[Jelph Marrian's farm|farm]] that was located next to the river.
